items.why: Fear is easing fast as buyers step in and forecasters say the worst of the sell-off is over and a new rally is starting.
AI stocks are rebounding as the Nasdaq rallies, with buyers stepping back in across tech.
Nvidia slides after CEO Jensen Huang apologized for an affair, with the board probing the case.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures up 2.33 percent and Nasdaq futures up 3.24 percent, with the VIX down sharply.
summary: Stocks are rallying into the afternoon, with the Nasdaq up as AI stocks rebound. Nvidia is the big outlier, sliding on the CEO controversy while the rest of the market climbs.
